g.text: Supply +V1/+V2 and -V1/-V2 are joined inside the supply, represented by wires inside its symbol.

g.desc: Supply +V1/+V2 and -V1/-V2 are joined inside the supply, represented by wires inside its symbol.

g.text: X means external wiring is not recorded; it does not prove that a terminal is unused in the real system.

g.desc: X means external wiring is not recorded; it does not prove that a terminal is unused in the real system.

g.text: CW/CCW plus: direct 3.3V GPIO as recorded. The AZD-K manual specifies 5-24V pulse inputs.

g.desc: CW/CCW plus: direct 3.3V GPIO as recorded. The AZD-K manual specifies 5-24V pulse inputs.

g.text: CN2/CN3 internal contact assignments, AC/PE and brake wiring remain unspecified.

g.desc: CN2/CN3 internal contact assignments, AC/PE and brake wiring remain unspecified.

g.text: Firmware and application are unchanged. Shared USB-powered 3V3 is a record of the existing wiring.

g.desc: Firmware and application are unchanged. Shared USB-powered 3V3 is a record of the existing wiring.

g.text: Every recorded net is drawn as a continuous wire. Labels identify wires; they do not replace a wire.

g.desc: Every recorded net is drawn as a continuous wire. Labels identify wires; they do not replace a wire.

g.text: Every external connection shown is a drawn wire. Crossing wires connect only where there is a dot.

g.desc: Every external connection shown is a drawn wire. Crossing wires connect only where there is a dot.

g.text: The two 24V negative rails remain separate from one another and from MCU GND.

g.desc: The two 24V negative rails remain separate from one another and from MCU GND.
